pairs.prompt: Renovation transformation of a kitchen. The honey-oak cabinets, beige tile backsplash and laminate counters are pulled out and replaced with white shaker cabinets, a brick-look backsplash and white quartz counters, while the camera slowly dollies back to reveal the new island. Photorealistic, bright natural interior light, smooth steady camera, no people, no text.

Renovation transformation of an open kitchen seen from the family room. The honey-oak cabinets and old island turn into white shaker cabinets and a large walnut-stained island with a white quartz top. Slow steady push-in. Photorealistic, bright natural light, no people, no text.

Renovation transformation of a bathroom. The beige tile tub surround, shower curtain and oak vanity are replaced with navy glazed subway tile, a sliding glass door with brass hardware, and a fluted white-oak vanity with brass knobs. Slow steady push toward the tub. Photorealistic, bright clean light, no people, no text.

Renovation transformation of a bathroom. The beige tile shower with framed glass door and oak vanity are replaced with a navy glazed tile walk-in shower behind frameless glass, a white vanity with brass pulls, and a brass-framed mirror. Slow steady camera drift. Photorealistic, bright clean light, no people, no text.
